description.en: Upon pickup, [gold]Enchant[/gold] a card with [gold]Encode[/gold] with [purple]Hardcoded[/purple].
description.zh: 拾起时，为一张带有[gold]编码[/gold]的牌[gold]附魔[/gold][purple]硬编码[/purple]。

description.en: Start each combat with an [gold]Encoded[/gold] [gold]Strike[/gold] and [gold]Defend[/gold].
description.zh: 在每场战斗开始时，[gold]编码[/gold]一张[gold]打击[/gold]和[gold]防御[/gold]。

description.en: [gold]Upgrade[/gold] the first [blue]{Cards:diff()}[/blue] unupgraded [gold]Encode[/gold] cards you draw each combat.
description.zh: 每场战斗中，[gold]升级[/gold]你抽到的前[blue]{Cards:diff()}[/blue]张未升级的[gold]编码[/gold]牌。

description.en: At the start of combat, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and add a [gold]Void[/gold] to your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
description.zh: 在每场战斗开始时，获得{Energy:energyIcons()}并将一张[gold]虚空[/gold]加入你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]。

description.en: Functions are now made up of [blue]4[/blue] cards.
description.zh: 方法现在由[blue]4[/blue]张牌组成。

description.en: Enchant all Functions you create with [purple]Steady[/purple].
description.zh: 你的所有方法附魔[purple]稳定[/purple]。

description.en: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and add a [gold]Slimed[/gold] to your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] at the start of your turn.
description.zh: 在你的回合开始时，获得{Energy:energyIcons()}并将一张[gold]粘液[/gold]加入你的[gold]弃牌堆[/gold]。

description.en: Whenever you [gold]Stash[/gold] a card, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it for the remainder of combat.
description.zh: 每当你[gold]暂存[/gold]一张牌时，将其[gold]升级[/gold]。

description.en:
Start each combat with an [gold]Encoded[/gold] [gold]Strike[/gold] and [gold]Defend[/gold].
At the start of your turn, add a random card with [gold]Encode[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
description.zh:
在每场战斗开始时，[gold]编码[/gold]一张[gold]打击[/gold]和一张[gold]防御[/gold]。
在你的回合开始时，将一张随机[gold]编码[/gold]牌加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

description.en: If you end your turn with no [gold]Encoded[/gold] cards, gain [blue]{Block:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
description.zh: 在你的回合结束时，若[gold]编码[/gold]队列中没有牌，获得[blue]{Block:diff()}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

description.en: Whenever you create a Status, deal [blue]{Damage:diff()}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
description.zh: 每当你生成一张状态牌时，对所有敌人造成[blue]{Damage:diff()}[/blue]点伤害。

description.en: The first time you are [gold]Drained[/gold] each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw a card.
description.zh: 每回合你第一次[gold]力竭[/gold]时，获得{Energy:energyIcons()}并抽1张牌。

description.en: The first [blue]4[/blue] times you play a Power each combat, heal [blue]3[/blue] HP.
description.zh: 每场战斗中，你前[blue]4[/blue]次打出能力牌时，回复[blue]3[/blue]点生命。

description.en: Upon pickup, [gold]Enchant[/gold] an Attack or Skill without [gold]Conjure[/gold] with [purple]Conjuration[/purple].
description.zh: 拾起时，选择一张非[gold]念咒[/gold]的攻击牌或技能牌，为其[gold]附魔[/gold]：[purple]咒术[/purple]。

description.en: [gold]Thunderbolt[/gold] and [gold]Darkleech[/gold] target ALL enemies.
description.zh: [gold]落雷[/gold]和[gold]暗噬[/gold]现在会命中所有敌人。

description.en: The [blue]3[/blue]rd time you activate [gold]Chant[/gold] effects in a combat, gain [blue]{RitualPower}[/blue] [gold]Ritual[/gold].
description.zh: 每场战斗中，你第[blue]3[/blue]次触发[gold]吟唱[/gold]效果时，获得[blue]{RitualPower}[/blue]层[gold]仪式[/gold]。

description.en: Whenever an enemy dies, transfer any [gold]Manaburn[/gold] it has to a random enemy and then trigger it.
description.zh: 每当一名敌人死亡时，将其拥有的[gold]魔力灼烧[/gold]转移给随机敌人并触发。

description.en: Enemies take [blue]25%[/blue] additional damage from [gold]Manaburn[/gold].
description.zh: 敌人受到[gold]魔力灼烧[/gold]的伤害提高[blue]25%[/blue]。

description.en: At the start of the first [blue]2[/blue] turns of combat, [gold]Conjure[/gold].
description.zh: 每场战斗前[blue]2[/blue]个回合开始时，[gold]念咒[/gold]。

description.en:
At the start of your turn, [gold]Conjure[/gold].
Start combat with [blue]{RitualPower:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Ritual[/gold].
description.zh:
在你的回合开始时，[gold]念咒[/gold]。
在每场战斗开始时，获得[blue]{RitualPower:diff()}[/blue]层[gold]仪式[/gold]。

description.en: Whenever you create a [gold]Void[/gold], apply [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Manaburn[/gold] to ALL enemies.
description.zh: 每当你生成一张[gold]虚空[/gold]时，给予所有敌人[blue]2[/blue]点[gold]魔力灼烧[/gold]。

description.en: Whenever you play a card with a [gold]Chant[/gold] effect, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold], even if it is not active.
description.zh: 每当你打出带有[gold]吟唱[/gold]效果的牌时，获得[blue]3[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]，即使尚未激活。

description.en: Start each combat with [gold]ESP[/gold] in your Spellbook.
description.zh: 将[gold]超感[/gold]加入你的法术书。

description.en: Every time you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Spells in a combat, gain a [gold]Ceremony[/gold].
description.zh: 每当你在一场战斗中打出[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张法术牌时，获得一张[gold]祭仪[/gold]。

description.en: Whenever you spend [gold]Vigor[/gold], gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] for every [blue]{VigorPower}[/blue] [gold]Vigor[/gold] spent.
description.zh: 每消耗[blue]{VigorPower}[/blue]点[gold]活力[/gold]，获得[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

description.en: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Vigor[/gold].
description.zh: 在你的回合开始时，获得[blue]3[/blue]点[gold]活力[/gold]。

description.en: The first time you enter each [gold]Stance[/gold] each combat: [gold]Defensive[/gold]: Gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold] and lose [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold]. [gold]Berserker[/gold]: Gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and lose [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
description.zh: 每场战斗中你首次进入每种[gold]姿态[/gold]时：[gold]防守[/gold]：获得[blue]2[/blue]点[gold]敏捷[/gold]并失去[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。[gold]战狂[/gold]：获得[blue]2[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]并失去[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]敏捷[/gold]。

description.en: Start each combat in a random [gold]Stance[/gold], and then trigger that [gold]Stance[/gold]'s [gold]Skill Bonus[/gold] twice.
description.zh: 在每场战斗开始时，进入随机[gold]姿态[/gold]并触发[gold]技术奖励[/gold]两次。

description.en: [gold]Defensive Stance[/gold]'s [gold]Finisher[/gold] Bonus grants [blue]3[/blue] more [gold]Block[/gold].
description.zh: [gold]防守姿态[/gold]的[gold]终结技[/gold]额外给予[blue]3[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

description.en: If you end your turn while in no [gold]Stance[/gold], draw [blue]1[/blue] additional card next turn.
description.zh: 如果你在没有[gold]姿态[/gold]时结束回合，下回合额外抽[blue]1[/blue]张牌。

description.en: Whenever you play a [gold]Combo[/gold], a [gold]Finisher[/gold], and enter a [gold]Stance[/gold] in the same turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
description.zh: 每当你在同一回合内打出[gold]连段[/gold]、打出[gold]终结技[/gold]并进入[gold]姿态[/gold]，获得[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]和[gold]敏捷[/gold]。

description.en: Start each combat with [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
description.zh: 每场战斗开始时，获得[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

description.en: Start each combat with [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold]. Your maximum [gold]Vigor[/gold] and [gold]Counter[/gold] is [blue]10[/blue].
description.zh: 每场战斗开始时，获得[blue]2[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。你的[gold]活力[/gold]和[gold]反击[/gold]上限为[blue]10[/blue]。

description.en: Upon pickup, [gold]Enchant[/gold] a [gold]Finisher[/gold] with [purple]Signature[/purple].
description.zh: 拾起时，选择一张[gold]终结技[/gold]牌为它[gold]附魔[/gold]：[purple]签名[/purple]。

description.en:
Whenever you enter a [gold]Stance[/gold], gain an [gold]Echo[/gold] of a [gold]Basic[/gold] [gold]Strike[/gold] or [gold]Defend[/gold].
It's free to play this turn.
description.zh:
每当你进入[gold]姿态[/gold]，获得一张[gold]打击[/gold]或[gold]防御[/gold]的[gold]回响[/gold]。
它在本回合可以免费打出。

description.en:
Start each combat in a random [gold]Stance[/gold], and then trigger that [gold]Stance[/gold]'s [gold]Skill Bonus[/gold] twice.
The first time you play a [gold]Finisher[/gold] each turn, draw [blue]2[/blue] cards and enter a random [gold]Stance[/gold].
description.zh:
每场战斗开始时，进入随机[gold]姿态[/gold]，然后触发该[gold]姿态[/gold]的[gold]技术奖励[/gold]两次。
每回合你第一次打出[gold]终结技[/gold]时，抽[blue]2[/blue]张牌并进入随机[gold]姿态[/gold]。

description.en: At the start of each combat, draw [blue]2[/blue] Collected cards.
description.zh: 在每场战斗开始时，抽[blue]2[/blue]张藏品牌。

description.en: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn. You don't draw from your Collected pile until your 4th turn.
description.zh: 在你的回合开始时，获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。直到第4回合才开始从藏品堆中抽牌。

description.en: Upon pickup, Upgrade a card in your Collection. Start combats with it on top of your Collected pile.
description.zh: 拾起时，选择一张收藏堆的牌升级，并在每场战斗开始时将其置于收藏堆顶部。

description.en: Start each combat with [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Reserve[/gold].
description.zh: 战斗开始时，获得[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]储能[/gold]。

description.en: Enemies take [blue]6[/blue] more damage from [gold]Doom[/gold].
description.zh: [gold]魂劫[/gold]额外造成[blue]6[/blue]点伤害。

description.en: When you would draw from an empty Collected pile, add a [gold]Lucky Wick[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
description.zh: 每当你尝试从空的收藏堆中抽牌，将一张[gold]幸运烛芯[/gold]添加到[gold]手牌[/gold]。

description.en: Replaces [aqua]Emerald Torch[/aqua]. At the start of each combat, add an [gold]Ember[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold] and gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Reserve[/gold]. The first time you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] an [gold]Ember[/gold] each turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Reserve[/gold].
description.zh: 替换[aqua]翠绿火炬[/aqua]。在每场战斗开始时，获得一张[gold]余烬[/gold]与[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]储能[/gold]。你每回合第一次消耗[gold]余烬[/gold]时，获得[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]储能[/gold]。

description.en: Upon pickup, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Essence[/gold]. At the start of combat, add an [gold]Ember[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
description.zh: 拾起时，获得[blue]3[/blue]点[gold]魂粹[/gold]。在每场战斗开始时，将一张[gold]余烬[/gold]加入[gold]手牌[/gold]。

description.en: Upon pickup, gain [blue]10[/blue] [gold]Essence[/gold].
description.zh: 拾起时，获得[blue]10[/blue]点[gold]魂粹[/gold]。

description.en: At the start of combat [gold]Kindle[/gold] [blue]3[/blue]. While [gold]Torchhead[/gold] is alive, cards grant [blue]1[/blue] additional [gold]Block[/gold].
description.zh: 在每场战斗开始时，[gold]点燃[/gold][blue]3[/blue]。当[gold]火炬头[/gold]存活时，从牌中获得额外[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

description.en: Damage dealt to random enemies is increased by 3.
description.zh: 随机对敌人造成的伤害增加3点。

description.en: Whenever a Gremlin dies, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
description.zh: 当地精死亡时，对所有敌人造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点伤害。

description.en: Dead Gremlins can be Resurrected at Rest Sites as a Free Action.
description.zh: 可在休息处随机复活（自由行动）一名死亡的地精。

description.en:
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn.
Upon pickup, permanently lose a Gremlin.
description.zh:
在你的回合开始时，获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。
拾起时，本局游戏永久失去一名地精。

description.en:
Whenever you gain [gold]Strength[/gold], gain an equal amount of [gold]Temporary HP[/gold].
Start each combat with 1 [gold]Strength[/gold].
description.zh:
每当你获得[gold]力量[/gold]时，获得等量[gold]临时生命[/gold]。
每场战斗开始时，获得1点[gold]力量[/gold]。

description.en: Whenever you apply [gold]Weak[/gold], gain [blue]{WizPower}[/blue] [gold]Wiz[/gold], up to 3 times per turn.
description.zh: 每回合，你前[blue]3[/blue]次给予[gold]虚弱[/gold]时，获得[blue]{WizPower}[/blue]点[gold]法力[/gold]。

description.en: The first time you shuffle your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card, and [gold]Swap[/gold] to the next Gremlin.
description.zh: The first time you shuffle your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card, and [gold]Swap[/gold] to the next Gremlin.

description.en: At the start of each combat, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards}, and [gold]Swap[/gold] to the next Gremlin.
description.zh: At the start of each combat, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards}, and [gold]Swap[/gold] to the next Gremlin.

description.en: The first time a Gremlin would die each combat, heal it to 75% of your Max HP instead.
description.zh: The first time a Gremlin would die each combat, heal it to 75% of your Max HP instead.

description.en: Whenever you Swap, gain an Echo of a random Colorless card. At the start of combat, the Merchant gains 2 Strength.
description.zh: Whenever you Swap, gain an Echo of a random Colorless card. At the start of combat, the Merchant gains 2 Strength.

description.en:
Whenever you draw [gold]Tag Team[/gold], draw another card.
Upon pickup, add two copies of [gold]Tag Team[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
description.zh:
Whenever you draw [gold]Tag Team[/gold], draw another card.
Upon pickup, add two copies of [gold]Tag Team[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].

description.en: Whenever you consume [gold]Wiz[/gold], remove a debuff at random.
description.zh: Whenever you consume [gold]Wiz[/gold], remove a debuff at random.

description.en: [gold]Wiz[/gold] deals [blue]{Damage}[/blue] additional damage.
description.zh: [gold]Wiz[/gold] deals [blue]{Damage}[/blue] additional damage.

description.en: At the end of each turn, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to each [gold]Weakened[/gold] enemy.
description.zh: At the end of each turn, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to each [gold]Weakened[/gold] enemy.

description.en: Whenever you [gold]Brace[/gold], [gold]Brace[/gold] [blue]{Brace:diff()}[/blue] more.
description.zh: 每当你[gold]提防[/gold]时，额外[gold]提防[/gold][blue]{Brace:diff()}[/blue]。

description.en: On pickup, [gold]Enchant[/gold] a card with [purple]Temporal[/purple].
description.zh: 拾取时，选择一张牌[gold]附魔[/gold][purple]时流[/purple]。

description.en:
At the start of each combat, add [gold]Gear Up[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Guardian starts the run with a random common [gold]Gem[/gold].
description.zh:
在每场战斗开始时，将一张[gold]预防[/gold]加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。
守护者开局时拥有一颗随机普通[gold]宝石[/gold]。

description.en: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Stasis[/gold] slot. Whenever a card enters [gold]Stasis[/gold], [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it for the remainder of combat.
description.zh: 在每场战斗开始时，获得[blue]1[/blue]个[gold]凝滞[/gold]栏位。每当你[gold]凝滞[/gold]一张牌时，本场战斗内将其[gold]升级[/gold]。

description.en:
At the start of each combat, add [gold]Gear Up[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Whenever you enter [gold]Defensive Mode[/gold], gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} and draw [blue]2[/blue] cards.
description.zh:
在每场战斗开始时，将一张[gold]预防[/gold]加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。
每当你进入[gold]防御模式[/gold]时，获得{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}并抽[blue]2[/blue]张牌。

description.en: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Thorns[/gold]. Whenever you are debuffed, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Thorns[/gold].
description.zh: 在每场战斗开始时，获得[blue]3[/blue]点[gold]荆棘[/gold]。每当你获得负面状态时，获得[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]荆棘[/gold]。

description.en: Whenever you defeat an Elite encounter, add a random [gold]Gem[/gold] to the rewards.
description.zh: 每当你击败精英时，获得一颗随机[gold]宝石[/gold]作为奖励。

description.en: At the start of each combat, put [blue]2[/blue] random cards in [gold]Stasis[/gold].
description.zh: 在每场战斗开始时，[gold]凝滞[/gold]随机[blue]2[/blue]张牌。

description.en: The first time you put a card into [gold]Stasis[/gold] each turn, [gold]Accelerate[/gold] it.
description.zh: 每回合你第一次[gold]凝滞[/gold]卡牌时，将其[gold]加速[/gold]。

description.en: Upon pickup, you may choose up to [blue]5[/blue] random [gold]Gems[/gold] to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
description.zh: 拾起时，你可以选择至多[blue]5[/blue]颗随机[gold]宝石[/gold]加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

description.en: At the start of each combat, lose [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Stasis[/gold] slot. Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn.
description.zh: 在每场战斗开始时，失去[blue]1[/blue]个[gold]凝滞[/gold]栏位。在你的回合开始时，获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。

description.en: Whenever you trigger a [gold]Dead On[/gold] effect, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
description.zh: 每当你触发[gold]精准[/gold]效果时，对所有敌人造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点伤害。

description.en: At the end of your turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
description.zh: 在你的回合结束时，获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

description.en: Whenever you defeat an Elite encounter, heal [blue]{Heal}[/blue] HP and gain [blue]{Gold}[/blue] gold.
description.zh: 每当你击败精英敌人时，回复[blue]{Heal}[/blue]点生命并获得[blue]{Gold}[/blue]金币。

description.en: Whenever you draw or create a [red]Curse[/red], gain [blue]{VigorPower}[/blue] [gold]Vigor[/gold].
description.zh: 每当你抽到或生成[red]诅咒[/red]时，获得[blue]{VigorPower}[/blue]点[gold]活力[/gold]。

description.en:
The first time you draw a [red]Curse[/red] each turn, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] it and draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards.
Upon pickup, obtain [blue]{Curses}[/blue] [red]Injuries[/red].
description.zh:
每回合你首次抽到[red]诅咒[/red]时，将其[gold]消耗[/gold]并抽[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。
拾起时，获得[blue]{Curses}[/blue]张[red]受伤[/red]。

description.en: While your HP is at or below [blue]50%[/blue], gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card at the start of your turn.
description.zh: 当你的生命值不高于[blue]50%[/blue]时，在你的回合开始时获得{Energy:energyIcons()}并抽[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。

description.en: Whenever you gain [gold]Weak[/gold], [gold]Frail[/gold] or [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], gain [blue]1[/blue] less.
description.zh: 每当你获得[gold]虚弱[/gold]、[gold]脆弱[/gold]或[gold]易伤[/gold]时，获得的层数减[blue]1[/blue]。

description.en: At the start of each combat, add a [gold]Memento[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
description.zh: 在每场战斗开始时，将一张[gold]纪念品[/gold]加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

description.en: Prevent your first lethal HP loss each combat.
description.zh: 每场战斗阻止你受到的第一次致命伤害。

description.en: Whenever you apply a new debuff to an enemy, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
description.zh: 每当你给予敌人一种新的负面状态时，获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

description.en: At the start of turn [blue]{Turn}[/blue], gain [blue]{RuggedPower:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Rugged[/gold].
description.zh: 在第[blue]{Turn}[/blue]回合开始时，获得[blue]{RuggedPower:diff()}[/blue]层[gold]坚固[/gold]。

description.en: The first {Limit:plural:time|[blue]{}[/blue] times} you use a potion each combat, procure a random potion. You can only use [blue]{Limit} [/blue]{Limit:plural:potion|potions} each combat.
description.zh: 每场战斗你最多能使用[blue]{Limit}[/blue]瓶药水。你在战斗中使用药水时，获取[blue]1[/blue]瓶随机药水。

description.en: The [blue]4th[/blue] card you play each turn triggers its [gold]Dead On[/gold] effect regardless of position.
description.zh: 你在每回合打出的第[blue]4[/blue]张牌必定触发[gold]精准[/gold]。

description.en: Whenever you remove or [gold]Transform[/gold] a card from your [gold]Deck[/gold], heal [blue]{Heal}[/blue] HP.
description.zh: 每当你从[gold]牌组[/gold]中移除或[gold]变化[/gold]一张牌时，回复[blue]{Heal}[/blue]点生命。

description.en: Start each combat with [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Intensity[/gold].
description.zh: 在每场战斗开始时，获得[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]热烈[/gold]。

description.en: Your [gold]Strikes[/gold] and [gold]Defends[/gold] count towards the progression of [gold]Crushing[/gold] and [gold]Searing Ghostflames[/gold].
description.zh: 你的[gold]打击[/gold]和[gold]防御[/gold]计入[gold]湮灭鬼火[/gold]和[gold]焚灼鬼火[/gold]的进度。

description.en: Whenever you [gold]Ignite[/gold] a Ghostflame, gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
description.zh: 每当你[gold]点燃[/gold]一枚鬼火时，获得[blue]4[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

description.en: Powers are counted towards the progression of [gold]Searing[/gold] and [gold]Crushing Ghostflames[/gold].
description.zh: 你的能力牌可以推进[gold]湮灭鬼火[/gold]和[gold]焚灼鬼火[/gold]的进度。

description.en: The first time a non-Status, non-Curse [gold]Ethereal[/gold] card is [gold]Exhausted[/gold] each combat, add a copy to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
description.zh: 每场战斗中，当你首次[gold]消耗[/gold]一张非状态非诅咒的[gold]虚无[/gold]牌时，将其一张复制加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

description.en: Whenever you apply [gold]Soulburn[/gold], apply [blue]2[/blue] additional [gold]Soulburn[/gold].
description.zh: 每当你给予[gold]灼魂[/gold]时，额外给予[blue]2[/blue]层。

description.en: The first time you [gold]Ignite[/gold] a Ghostflame each turn, you may choose to [gold]Advance[/gold] or [gold]Retract[/gold].
description.zh: 每回合你第一次[gold]点燃[/gold]鬼火时，选择[gold]步进[/gold]或[gold]回退[/gold]。

description.en: Whenever you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] [blue]4[/blue] cards, [gold]Ignite[/gold] the current Ghostflame.
description.zh: 你每[gold]消耗[/gold][blue]4[/blue]张牌，[gold]点燃[/gold]当前鬼火。

description.en: The first time you [gold]Ignite[/gold] a Ghostflame each turn, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
description.zh: 每回合你首次[gold]点燃[/gold]鬼火时，获得[blue]3[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

description.en: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]6[/blue], then heal all of your HP. Start each combat with [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold], [gold]Dexterity[/gold], and [gold]Intensity[/gold]. You can not receive [gold]The Broken Seal[/gold] and other [gold]Seals[/gold] again.
description.zh: 拾取时，将你的最大生命提高[blue]6[/blue]，然后回复所有生命。每场战斗开始时，获得[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]、[gold]敏捷[/gold]和[gold]热烈[/gold]。你无法再次获得[gold]破碎封印[/gold]或其他[gold]封印[/gold]。

description.en: Whenever you [gold]Consume[/gold], heal [blue]{Heal}[/blue] HP, up to [blue]{MaxUses}[/blue] each combat.
description.zh: 每当你[gold]吞食[/gold]时，回复[blue]{Heal}[/blue]点生命，每场战斗最多回复[blue]{MaxUses}[/blue]点。

description.en: At the start of each combat, [gold]Split[/gold] into a [gold]Bruiser Slime[/gold].
description.zh: 在每场战斗开始时，[gold]分裂[/gold]出一个[gold]好斗史莱姆[/gold]。

description.en: At the start of each combat, spawn Greed Ooze (can be revived if Absorbed. At Rest Sites, Greed Ooze will take 50 of your souls, increasing its damage by 1.
description.zh: 战斗开始时，生成贪婪史莱姆（若被吸收可复活。在休息处，贪婪软泥会吞噬你50个灵魂并提高1点伤害）。

description.en: Whenever you [gold]Consume[/gold], heal [blue]{Heal}[/blue] HP, up to [blue]{MaxUses}[/blue] each combat.
description.zh: 每当你[gold]吞食[/gold]时，回复[blue]{Heal}[/blue]点生命，每场战斗最多回复[blue]{MaxUses}[/blue]点。

description.en: At the start of each combat, gain 1 Slime slot and [gold]Split[/gold] into a random Slime.
description.zh: 在每场战斗开始时，获得1个史莱姆槽位并[gold]分裂[/gold]出一个随机史莱姆。

description.en: Reduce the damage you take from Tackles by [blue]{TackleReduce}[/blue].
description.zh: 降低你从“冲撞”牌中受到的伤害[blue]{TackleReduce}[/blue]点。

description.en: At the start of each combat, spawn Scrap Ooze (can be revived if Absorbed. At Rest Sites, you can donate a card to the Scrap Ooze, modifying its +1 damage for Uncommons +2 damage for Rares -1 damage for Commons -2 damage for {{QueryLink|Cards|type:Curse|Curses}}
description.zh: 战斗开始时，生成废料软泥（若被吸收可复活。在休息处，你可以将一张牌交给废料软泥并修改其伤害：普通牌+1，稀有牌+2，基础牌-1，{{QueryLink|Cards|type:Curse|诅咒牌}}-2）。

description.en: Whenever you [gold]Split[/gold], gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
description.zh: 每当你[gold]分裂[/gold]时，获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

description.en: Whenever you apply [gold]Goop[/gold], apply an additional [blue]{GoopIncrease}[/blue] [gold]Goop[/gold].
description.zh: 每当你给予[gold]黏液[/gold]时，额外给予[blue]{GoopIncrease}[/blue]层[gold]黏液[/gold]。

description.en: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{PotencyPower}[/blue] [gold]Potency[/gold].
description.zh: 在每场战斗开始时，获得[blue]{PotencyPower}[/blue]点[gold]潜能[/gold]。

description.en:
At the start of each combat, lose [blue]{Decrease}[/blue] Slime {Decrease:plural:slot|slots}.
At the start of your turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
description.zh:
在每场战斗开始时，失去[blue]{Decrease}[/blue]个史莱姆槽位。
在你的回合开始时，获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。

description.en: Whenever a card is [gold]Muddled[/gold], gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
description.zh: 每当你[gold]混淆[/gold]一张牌时，获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

description.en: Upon pickup, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] Characters. Obtain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Upgraded[/gold] [gold]Uncommon[/gold] cards and [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Rare[/gold] cards. All combats drop an additional card reward of the chosen character's cards.
description.zh: 拾起时，从[blue]3[/blue]个角色中选择[blue]1[/blue]个，获得来自该角色的[blue]3[/blue]组已[gold]升级[/gold]的[gold]罕见[/gold]牌奖励和[blue]2[/blue]组[gold]稀有[/gold]牌奖励。每次战斗结束后，额外掉落一组该角色的卡牌奖励。

description.en: Upon pickup, [gold]Enchant[/gold] an [gold]Overflow[/gold] card with [purple]Loaded[/purple].
description.zh: 拾起时，选择一张[gold]溢出[/gold]牌，[gold]附魔[/gold]：[purple]注料[/purple]。

description.en: Upon pickup, obtain an [gold]Offclass[/gold] Rare card.
description.zh: 拾起时，获得一张稀有[gold]异色[/gold]牌。

description.en: Whenever you activate [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Overflow[/gold] effects, apply [blue]{WeakPower}[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] and [blue]{VulnerablePower}[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to a random enemy.
description.zh: 每当你触发[blue]{Cards}[/blue]次[gold]溢出[/gold]时，给予随机敌人[blue]{WeakPower}[/blue]层[gold]虚弱[/gold]和[blue]{VulnerablePower}[/blue]层[gold]易伤[/gold]。

description.en: Upon pickup, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]5[/blue] Uncommon [gold]Offclass[/gold] Powers to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
description.zh: 拾起时，从[blue]5[/blue]张罕见[gold]异色[/gold]能力牌中选择[blue]1[/blue]张加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

description.en: At the start of each combat, gain a [gold]Marked Card+[/gold].
description.zh: 在每场战斗开始时，将一张[gold]记号牌+[/gold]加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

description.en: [gold]Muddled[/gold] cards can't cost [blue]3[/blue].
description.zh: [gold]混淆[/gold]后耗能不为[blue]3[/blue]。

description.en: At the start of each combat, add [gold]Soul Roll[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
description.zh: 在每场战斗开始时，将一张[gold]灵魂骰掷[/gold]加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

description.en:
At the start of each combat, add [gold]Soul Roll[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
At the start of your turn, draw a card and [gold]Muddle[/gold] it.
description.zh:
每场战斗回合开始时，获得一张[gold]灵魂骰掷[/gold]。
在你的回合开始时，抽1张牌并将其[gold]混淆[/gold]。

description.en:
Whenever you add an [gold]Offclass[/gold] card to your [gold]Deck[/gold], [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it.
Upon pickup, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random [gold]Offclass[/gold] cards.
description.zh:
每当你将一张[gold]异色[/gold]牌加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]时，将其[gold]升级[/gold]。
拾起时，随机[gold]升级[/gold][blue]{Cards}[/blue]张[gold]异色牌[/gold]。
